---
title: Quarto extensions
author: Mickaël Canouil
format: mcanouil-revealjs
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    footer:
      centre: page
      right: title
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: A deck with page in the centre footer slot turns the slide number off, with one warning, since Reveal.js draws it on the right only.
        warnings: exhaustive
    mcanouil-revealjs:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        level: WARN
        regex: 'mcanouil: the deck footer has no "page" in its right slot, so the slide number is off'
        count: 1
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['slideNumber: false', '<span class="mc-slot mc-slot-centre"></span>', '<span class="mc-slot mc-slot-right">Quarto extensions</span>']
        - ['mc-slot-page', "slideNumber: 'c/t'"]
---

## A slide

A paragraph.
